title: Line sketch: Vibrant Pebble Mosaic Orb
description: Black-and-white ink line sketch on white paper — pure contour and edge drawing with no color fills. Edge-traced line art of: A glossy glass sphere rests among smooth river stones, its surface revealing a vivid, pebble beach scene with waters and distant cliffs.
